title: ReadSelection
description: Placement selection for reads, recall, reflections, and subject exports (§6.12). No mode is expressed by null/empty-array overloading.

mode.description: subject_all = every record of the subject regardless of placement or provenance (requires an unrestricted grant); shared_only = scope.visibility shared only (requires shared access); selected_contexts = records placed in context_ids, plus shared records iff include_shared.

context_ids.description: Required iff mode = "selected_contexts"; MUST be omitted otherwise.

include_shared.description: Allowed only with mode = "selected_contexts"; omission there means false. MUST be omitted for other modes.
